Methods & Expertise

Start with a question.
Connect the methods.

We connect clinical questions with cellular, tissue and data-based evidence. These approaches are represented in our published experiments and collaborations.

OUR APPROACH

Identify a candidate from observations. Test it through perturbation. Return to human skin and clinical context.

01 / Published experience

Cell models & mechanistic testing

Gene perturbation in UV- and oxidative-stress models of human dermal fibroblasts links candidate pathways to senescence and molecular readouts.

Gene overexpression / knockdownSA-β-galqPCR / immunoblottingSASP-related expression

02 / Published experience

Transcriptome integration & cell states

Integration of study-generated bulk and single-cell RNA-seq with public datasets identifies candidates and cell states. Trajectory, regulatory-network and cell-interaction inference generates hypotheses for functional testing.

06 / Published experience

Skin imaging & data-analysis collaborations

We collaborate with optical and engineering researchers on skin-image interpretation and quantitative assessment. Image processing and AI-based analyses are used where relevant to the research question, with attention to clinical meaning and applicability.

07 / Published experience

Medical devices, EBD & outcome assessment

Our clinical study used 3D imaging to quantify facial-pore changes after combined microfocused ultrasound and intradermal incobotulinumtoxin-A, connecting treatment conditions with objective outcome assessment.

Microfocused ultrasound3D imaging / pore quantificationClinical outcome assessment
